name: Logistics Excellence, Advancement, and Performance Shield
_eligibility_text: **A. Core logistics and Special categories** 1. The applicant must be a company registered in India under the Companies Act of 2013 or a partnership firm registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act of 2008. 2. The entity must possess all relevant trade-specific registrations, such as GST Registration, etc. 3. The entity, its promoters, or any of their affiliated entities must not have incurred any defaults in the last three fiscal years (FY 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25). 4. The entity must submit audited financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss account) for the last three financial years (FY 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25). **B. Startups** 1. The startup should be a DPIIT recognized startup. The entity must submit their certificate of incorporation or partnership deed. 2. The entity must have a hardware or software product or a process solution that is present in the market. 3. The entity must have all applicable trade or trade-specific registrations (Example: FSSAI, MSME, GST Registration, etc.) 4. The entity, its promoters, or any of their affiliated entities must not have incurred any defaults in the last three fiscal years (FY 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25). 5. The entity must submit audited financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss account) for the last three financial years (FY 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25). **C. MSMEs** 1. The entity should be a recognized MSME entity (Udyam Aadhar). The entity must submit their certificate of incorporation or partnership deed. 2. The entity must have all applicable trade or trade-specific registrations (example: MSME, GST Registration, etc.) 3. The entity, its promoters, or any of their affiliated entities must not have incurred any defaults in the last three fiscal years (FY 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25). 4. The entity must submit audited financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss account) for the last three financial years (FY 2022-23, 23-24, 24-25). **D. Institutions:** 1. Institution must also be officially registered with the appropriate educational or governmental authorities. 2. This should include accreditation from national or regional educational bodies.
